top.line: A startup needs something very easy; building from the bottom up ended in one anyway.

in-short.line: Narrow, easy, scalable; provenance and determinism; a site from a QR code; each layer learnt on its own.

need.line: Find something very easy, narrow and scalable; SG/Send taught that the use case must be there.

bottom-up.line: Provenance, understanding, determinism, no black magic, and the result is simple for the person.

layers.line: CI first, zero knowledge, selling, sgit, vaults, QR codes, agentic teams, the factory.

dots.line: Connecting them was possible because each was lived and understood; not in love with any technology.

moat.line: Open code can be copied; the order of learning and the velocity cannot.

limits.line: Dates as recorded; the demo pipeline is not built; simple means the person's experience.

sources.line: From sending a file to sgit, the QR, vault, factory and second-run pieces, PrompTugal's deck.
